condition: With dtype_backend="pyarrow", the "string[pyarrow]" alias passed in dtype maps to StringDtype("pyarrow") rather than ArrowDtype(pa.string()), so that column ends up with a different dtype from the other columns.
workaround: Pass dtype={"col": pd.ArrowDtype(pyarrow.string())} instead of the "string[pyarrow]" alias.
